text:
Anna Park: Heads-up: opened a docs PR to consolidate the Dedicated Capacity handbook + migration guide. Links broken in a couple pages; need reviewers on autoscale policy wording and the SLA table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 cc @Samir Patel @Maya Chen
Samir Patel: On it — I'll skim the autoscale policy section tonight. Is there a preferred canonical Terraform example? we currently have two variants floating around.
Maya Chen: I can take the SDK snippet and the migration checklist. Found one stray link to /dedicated/old-provisioning -> should be /dedicated/provisioning.
Jared: FYI: ops reported confusion around the "preemption" wording in the SLA table. Suggest adding a short footnote + expand the isolation paragraph to clarify eviction behavior.
Anna Park: Thanks. Proposed Terraform example (short):
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "prod" {
  region      = "us-west-2"
  gpu_type    = "a100"
  min_replicas = 2
  max_replicas = 10
  isolation   = "tenant"
}
```
Does that align with current runtime semantics?
Eli (eng): Small nit: runtime now supports `burst_capacity` boolean, we should add it to the example or a footnote. Also note that `min_replicas = 0` is allowed for burst-only configs.
Maya Chen: SDK snippet (python) I'll drop in the PR, roughly:
```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_pool(region='us-west-2', gpu_type='a100', min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, isolation='tenant')
```
Will link to the SDK reference.
Samir Patel: For autoscale policy wording I prefer `scale_to_target_qps` instead of `target_utilization` — clearer for product teams. I'll propose wording and a compact JSON example.
Samir Patel: Example autoscale policy (JSON):
```json
{
  "autoscale": {
    "policy": "scale_to_target_qps",
    "target_qps": 1200,
    "min_replicas": 2,
    "max_replicas": 12,
    "cooldown_secs": 60
  }
}
```
Anna Park: Perfect. Can reviewers add LGTM or leave comments by EOD Friday? Want to merge before the next release cut.
docs-bot: PR #1427 status: open — reviewers requested: Samir Patel, Maya Chen.
Jared: I'll add a one-line footnote in the SLA table re: preemption (link to dedicated preemption policy).
Maya Chen: Also: fixed a broken anchor on `isolation-decorators` in the PR and added a short canary rollout example: `rollout_policy: canary(10%)`.
Anna Park: :thumbsup: thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me here. I'll merge after 2 LGTMs + no critical comments.
